paper.title: $m^\ast$ of two-dimensional electron gas: a neural canonical transformation study
paper.authors: Hao Xie, Linfeng Zhang, Lei Wang

results.system_description: 2D homogeneous electron gas, N = 37 (37 up, 0 down), r_s = 5, square cell, Gamma point
results.variant: neural canonical transformation (FermiNet-block normalizing-flow backflow), T->0
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational Monte Carlo energy of the neural-network wave function (neural canonical transformation (FermiNet-block normalizing-flow backflow), T->0) at this N, r_s and cell, without finite-size correction or twist averaging.
results.notes: As printed (energy per electron, in Rydberg). The paper uses Rydberg units, so the printed energy and error bar are multiplied by convention_factor 0.5 to give Hartree. Madelung term: "const." = neutralizing background / Madelung term (commented-out definition in source), Ewald. Boundary: zero-T benchmark: not stated (Gamma inferred: N=37 is closed shell at Gamma in a square box). Finite-T effective-mass runs use TABC via a single twist (pi/2,pi/2) = 2x2 Monkhorst-Pack.
